def plain_text(value):
    if value is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return value
    try:

        return str(value)
    except Exception:

    if color is None:

    return False

def run_text(run):

        body = r"\s+".join(pieces)

        return re.compile(body, re.IGNORECASE)
